parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This is one half of the scissors consisting of a blade and a handle loop, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It provides one cutting edge and one handle loop for gripping and applying force during cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the screw joint to open and close against the other blade handle set.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This is the second half of the scissors, also consisting of a blade and a handle loop, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the opposing cutting edge and handle loop, working together with the first blade handle set to perform cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw joint, moving in coordination with the other blade handle set.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: This is the central screw that connects the two blade handle sets, made of steel.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as the pivot point allowing the two blades to rotate relative to each other.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed in place, allowing rotational movement of the two blade handle sets around it.
